title: Day and Trial Passes: per-tier rolling-year purchase cap and its counting window
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: the maximum number of passes of a given tier a visitor may purchase within a rolling window, and the length in days of that rolling window.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Maximum passes per rolling year | Rolling window (days) |
|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | 6 | 365 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | 2 | 365 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | 1 | 365 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | 0 (no cap) | 365 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | 1 | 365 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | 12 | 365 |

The maximum passes per rolling year is the greatest number of that tier's passes a visitor may purchase within the rolling window, where that value is set above zero; a value of zero, as set for the Weekly Visitor Pass, means no per-tier cap applies to that tier. The rolling window in days is the length of the trailing period used to count a visitor's prior passes of that tier. Every tier that does set a cap uses the same 365-day rolling window.
